title: SCCP: folding and pruning together
hook: How does sparse conditional constant propagation fold code and prove branches dead at once?

scenes.caption: Each SSA value sits on a three-level lattice: unknown, a single constant, or overdefined.
scenes.narration: SCCP tracks each SSA value on a small lattice: unknown, one specific constant, or overdefined. Values only ever move downward.

scenes.caption: Here the branch condition depends on a constant, so only one successor may ever execute.
scenes.narration: Here x is the constant one, so the comparison is true and only the then-edge can ever execute. The else-block is never reached.

elements.text:
entry:
  %x = add i32 0, 1
  %c = icmp eq i32 %x, 1
  br i1 %c, %then, %else
then:  %y1 = 2   ; br join
else:  %y2 = 3   ; br join
join:
  %y = phi [ %y1, %then ],
           [ %y2, %else ]
  %z = add i32 %y, 4

scenes.caption: Two worklists drive it: executable CFG edges and SSA def-use edges, visited only when reachable.
scenes.narration: Two worklists drive it: flow edges and SSA edges. Only blocks reached through executable edges are evaluated, and the folded condition marks just one successor.

items: Start: entry edge executable, values unknown
Mark only the then edge executable
else block is never visited: it stays unknown

scenes.caption: The phi meets only executable incoming edges, so it folds to 2 and z folds to 6.
scenes.narration: A phi merges only values from executable edges. The else edge is dead, so y is two and z folds to six, proven together.

elements.text: A pessimistic pass sees 2 and 3 and gives up. SCCP assumes unknown until proven.

scenes.caption: Each value can only be lowered twice, so SCCP runs in time linear in the size of the SSA graph.
scenes.narration: Each value descends at most twice, so the pass is linear in SSA edges. LLVM ships it as sccp, and ipsccp extends it across functions.

items: Dead blocks are then cleaned by simplifycfg

takeaway: SCCP interleaves constant propagation with reachability, so folding a branch condition proves code dead and sharper constants emerge in one linear pass.
